theorem exists_coefficientProfile {h j σ : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    (d : AnalyticInputs h j σ P0) (hsmall : NaturalAxisRange.Parameters h j)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 < M ∧ ∀ Λ : ℝ, M ≤ Λ → ∀ C : ℝ,
      d.normalizationThreshold Λ ≤ C → Nonempty (CoefficientProfile d Λ C)
